Margen de calado dinámico

An additional draught margin included to account for dynamic effects such as squat, trim, and vessel movement in shallow waters.

Questions and answers

What is Margen de calado dinámico?

In this glossary, Margen de calado dinámico refers to: An additional draught margin included to account for dynamic effects such as squat, trim, and vessel movement in shallow waters.

How is Margen de calado dinámico used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Práctico al puente: Confirme que el margen de calado dinámico ha sido calculado antes de pasar la sección poco profunda del canal."

Definition

An additional draught margin included to account for dynamic effects such as squat, trim, and vessel movement in shallow waters.

Operational example

Pilot to bridge: Confirm dynamic draught allowance has been calculated before proceeding past the shallow section of channel.

Localized term

Margen de calado dinámico

Localized example

Práctico al puente: Confirme que el margen de calado dinámico ha sido calculado antes de pasar la sección poco profunda del canal.
